title: Surreal Desert Muse
description: A surreal portrait of a woman's head split into two faces: a pale, cracked, closed-eyed face on the left and a vibrant purple-skinned profile with colorful makeup on the right. Her hair flows into a cosmic nebula containing a glowing golden fleur-de-lis, set against a desert landscape with sand dunes, a lone distant figure, a large pink moon, and a red mouse on a rock in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal dreamlike portrait of a woman whose head is divided between a cracked pale marble-like face with closed eyes and a vibrant purple profile with bold colorful eye makeup. Her voluminous flowing hair transforms into a swirling cosmic nebula with stars and a glowing golden fleur-de-lis at the center. Set in a vast desert with rolling sand dunes, a lone figure walking in the distance, a large luminous pink moon in the sky, and a detailed red mouse standing on a rock in the foreground, intricate line work with golden cracks, vibrant yet melancholic atmosphere.
